tagline: Every step toward her is a clue, and clues buy the exact answer she needs

featuredCards.title: Connecting the Dots
featuredCards.caption: Card or clue, your choice — and four banked clues later it deletes your value outright.

featuredCards.title: At the Scene of the Crime
featuredCards.caption: Defends by milling you, and the size of what she binned is the size of the payout.

featuredCards.title: Master Sleuth
featuredCards.caption: Worth +1 for every clue on the board and spends none of them. The bank is the card.

featuredCards.title: Crack The Case!
featuredCards.caption: Five clues and the boost doubles. This is what she has been saving for since turn one.
